ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 2.5:1 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous regions covering central lobes; dark black border along trailing edge; dark triangular patch at median notch; multiple dark parallel linear streaks on left lobe distal area.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel-derived angle of 135 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge with peak-to-valley heights ranging from 3 to 8 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve across the trailing edge extending to sharp distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small clusters of dark pixels on the right lobe, appearing as focal spots against the white background.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct parallel dark linear disruptions on the left lobe, identified as high-contrast rake marks.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake mark scarring on both lobes, particularly visible as parallel dark lines on the white ventral surface of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Vertical pixel streams indicating water runoff from the right fluke tip.
